dedupe_keys.name: rooftop aware optimization of electric bus depot charging photovoltaic generation and battery storage under grid capacity constraints

description: Jorge Romero-Gelvez and Sebastian Zapata publish an optimisation package for electric-bus depots in Bogotá. The Zenodo release is open under MIT and links a public repository. Its README identifies processed depot-hour demand, depot parameters, scenarios, prices, emissions, roof photovoltaic potential and route-to-depot assignments, plus code and reference CSV outputs. The model combines bus charging, rooftop PV and batteries under grid-capacity constraints and can test charging infrastructure and energy-system investment choices. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Bogotá depot experiment. Coverage is the configured TransMilenio and SITP depot cases, not every bus garage in Colombia. A limitation is that the repository does not redistribute third-party raw data or large geospatial inputs; the published processed files must be checked against their provenance inventory before transfer to another city. The paper is described as a manuscript, not established as published. Code and results were not run or recalculated.
